problem_statement:
Access tokens remain valid for one extra second after they expire.

When the token TTL is reached exactly, is_expired still returns False, so validate_token accepts an expired token. The comparison against the TTL looks off by one.
patch:
diff --git a/src/auth/token.py b/src/auth/token.py
--- a/src/auth/token.py
+++ b/src/auth/token.py
@@ -10,7 +10,7 @@
-        return time.time() - issuedAt > self.ttl
+        return time.time() - issuedAt >= self.ttl

problem_statement:
Request header lookup should be case insensitive.

Calling get_header('Content-Type') fails when the client sent 'content-type'. HTTP header names are case insensitive per RFC 7230.
patch:
diff --git a/src/http/request.py b/src/http/request.py
--- a/src/http/request.py
+++ b/src/http/request.py
@@ -5,4 +5,4 @@
-        return self.headers.get(name)
+        return self.headers.get(name.lower())

problem_statement:
format_duration does not handle durations longer than an hour.

Passing 7200 returns '120m0s' instead of '2h0m0s'. The duration formatting helper needs an hours component.
patch:
diff --git a/src/utils/dates.py b/src/utils/dates.py
--- a/src/utils/dates.py
+++ b/src/utils/dates.py
@@ -7,3 +7,5 @@
-    minutes, sec = divmod(int(seconds), 60)
-    return f"{minutes}m{sec}s"
+    hours, rem = divmod(int(seconds), 3600)
+    minutes, sec = divmod(rem, 60)
+    return f"{hours}h{minutes}m{sec}s"
